share_display_sources.source: Exit BERNARDO.

Psst! Have you spoken to Father today? He's in a fit!
About this cursed book...
Are you looking forward to performing again in Elsinore?
Bernardo believes a foreign spy may be embedded in Elsinore. What do you know?
Bernardo believes a spy in Elsinore. Have you seen anything amiss?
Bernardo believes a spy may be hiding in Elsinore. What do you know?
Bernardo believes there might be a spy in the castle. What do you know?
Bernardo would like to meet with you privately. Could you report to him, please?
Bernardo, I have proof of Fortinbras's plan to betray Denmark. He's hiding out in Castle Town.
Bernardo, I have proof that King Claudius murdered his own brother.
Bernardo, I need you to help me protect the castle against Peter Quince.
Bernardo, you've got to believe me—Lady Brit is leaking information to Fortinbras's army.
Bernardo. You're someone I know I can trust.
Brit asked me to facilitate a 'rendezvous' between herself and Hamlet.
Brit, I know you've been leaking information to Fortinbras.
Brit, do you believe King Claudius truly wants me dead because of my prior relationship with Hamlet?
Brit, do you know why the guards would believe they were on 'thin ice' with Bernardo?
Brit. Wait a moment.
Brit. What do you know of King Hamlet's mother, Queen Astrid?
Can you encourage Hamlet to be a great King? He seeks the advice of wise folk.
Can you encourage Hamlet to be a great king? He's seeking advice from friends.
Can you tell me anything about your history with Horatio?
Cygnus at the town gate is acting strangely. Something about being 'on thin ice' and 'winnings.' Do you know why?
Did Hamlet actually see his father's ghost?
Did you know Prince Hamlet and I were once in a relationship?
Did you know the Queen was having an affair with King Claudius before her husband's death?
Do you know anything about the strange vision I've been having? The one where all the castle dies?
Do you know much about Queen Astrid?
Do you know where Bernardo goes at night?
Do you know why Queen Gertrude might be rummaging through her husband's things in secret?
Does Peter Quince seem a bit strange to you, my King?
Does Peter Quince seem a bit strange to you?
Does Peter Quince seem at all odd to you?
Does Peter Quince's behavior seem unusual to you?
Don't take this the wrong way, but -- what if Hamlet and I began seeing each other again?
Father, I found a note from Laertes on your desk about his lute.
Father, I have proof of Fortinbras's plan to betray Denmark. He's hiding out in Castle Town.
Father, I have reason to believe Lady Simona is alive.
Father, I heard the worrying news about a spy in the castle.
Father, I know for certain that Lord Fortinbras is going to invade, violating the peace treaty.
